_README: Purpose-built extract of data/the-program.json for the L0 map design work. The full file is 6.4MB and the GitHub read integration caps around 1MB, which is why you could not fetch it, program-people.js, program-entities.js, program-edges.js or dist/. NOTHING IS MISSING FROM THE REPO - all of those are tracked and pushed. This file carries every field the L0 question needs. Generated from the-program.json, board commit 9ccc25d.
_orphan_definitions: detail_class_orphans counts person/document/domain/location only - this is the 346 figure the brief quoted at floor 6. all_below_L0_orphans also counts structural nodes that missed the floor. after_2hop = STILL unreachable even allowing second-hop routing through an intermediate node. after_2hop is the number that decides the reachability argument.
